definitions.gloss: appetizing; to whet one's appetite; mouth-watering
definitions.explanation: Describes food, aromas, or sights that stimulate the desire to eat.

examples.japanese: {食欲|しょくよく}をそそる⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧だ。
{焼|や}き{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{食欲|しょくよく}をそそる。
examples.english: The smell of grilled meat whets the appetite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{色鮮|いろあざ}やか→色鮮やか：15312_iroazayaka⟧な⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{食欲|しょくよく}をそそり、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The colorful presentation was so appetizing that I couldn't help taking a photo.

notes:
A very common expression for describing food that makes you want to eat. ⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧ means "to stimulate" or "to arouse," and ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧ means "appetite."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食欲|しょくよく}をそそる⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: an appetizing aroma
- {食欲|しょくよく}をそそる⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧: an appetizing appearance
- {食欲|しょくよく}をそそられる: to have one's appetite stimulated (passive/spontaneous)

THE VERB そそる:
⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧ ({唆|そそ}る) means to incite, to stimulate, or to provoke. It appears in several set expressions:
- ⟦{好奇心|こうきしん}→好奇心：05213_koukishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧: to arouse curiosity
- ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧: to arouse interest
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧: to bring someone to tears

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おいしそう: looks delicious — simpler, more casual
- {美味|おい}しそうな⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧: a smell that suggests it's delicious — everyday phrasing
- ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: appetite wells up — describes the internal feeling rather than the stimulus
